researchObjects.judgment: Resumable Digital Employees should govern late operator input through durable occurrence identity, explicit admission, guardrail validation and consumption evidence; exactly-once scope must not be overstated across external side effects.

Semantic multi-agent recovery should reconcile against an independently authoritative state lineage; retry restores execution but cannot repair latent corruption when the same bad state remains authoritative.
Tool-runtime lifecycle operations require one serialized transition authority, bounded and cancellation-safe cleanup, preserved failure state, and fencing before a replacement generation starts.
